rules.requirement: Each artifact reference must resolve inside the role allowlist; enforce tool/file scope beyond prompt text.
Verify SHA256, source/resource build and loaded assembly identity, scenario, state and action parameters before reusing evidence.

Verifier/visual calls use unrelated random review_session_id and artifact aliases. Exclude chronology, intended change, editor attempted report, benefit predictions, revealing paths and EXIF/metadata. Keep private mapping only in runner logs.
Bind full action parameters, physical entity IDs, native pre/post state, RNG, UI panel/page/selection and A-end pointer continuity. Native restore alone never proves an actual pointer route.
Every scored side or visual observation must cite an image actually attached or successfully opened in that role session. Match frame ID and checksum to the corresponding anonymous pair.
A confirmed issue/repair_packet must reference current-build evidence; speculative or mismatched findings cannot authorize an edit.

Calculate costs independently of Editor, from actual candidate geometry and legal route mappings. A layout outside v2-v7 transform support requires a new independently checked compiler, not reuse of stale hardcoded coordinates.
Preserve frozen original-completable population and frequency weights; any newly unavailable candidate intent fails the gate. Original unavailable and unobserved stay separate and null-valued.

A promote recommendation cannot execute without complete evidence, all required hard gates pass, validated same-intent results, fixed denominator, valid blind reviews and the pre-frozen promotion policy.
Missing image, invalid JSON, bridge timeout or stale assembly yields unknown/needs_evidence; it is not a product pass, verified failure or a no-gain checkpoint.
Never admit fixture_only examples or unregistered demo references into a real decision, checklist certification or champion update.
